job.question: A county pension fund is searching for a single manager of managers covering domestic equity, international equity and fixed income. What is the maximum mandate size, and what is the firm-level AUM limit for responders?
job.expected_facts: A mandate of up to $350 million; responders must have less than $30 billion in firm-level assets under management (Cook County Fund, RFP 25-0004).
job.acceptance: Accept up to $350m and firm AUM strictly below $30bn. Cook County identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Oklahoma OPERS index-management RFP, not the county fund’s manager-of-managers RFP. It does not support a mandate of up to $350 million or a firm-level AUM limit below $30 billion; instead, it requires at least $10 billion in firm-wide AUM.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-24-001
Prospective vendors may provide a proposal for all, several, or one of the mandates listed below.
The proposed investment management firm must have assets under management (firm-wide) of at least $10 billion as of June 30, 2023.
